request.acceptance_criteria: The workerd/WebAssembly question is answered; Hegel property tests cover the supervision loop as a state machine plus the four other targets; they run in pnpm test and CI; anything found is fixed or recorded with its minimal counterexample
request.description:
Operator, 2026-09-27: trial Hegel's TypeScript library (@hegeldev/hegel, https://hegel.dev/typescript; Node 20.11+; v0.4.7 adds a WebAssembly build of the engine) on the cloudflare/ side.

FIRST: check whether the WebAssembly build loads under workerd (vitest-pool-workers). If it does not, run these tests under plain-Node vitest over pure modules, and say so.

Targets:
- The Run Workflow's supervision loop as a state machine: boot, observe, done signal, timeout, reboot, finalize. Properties:
  - every path reaches finalize (0ye's bug class)
  - a container that cannot be asked is never read as dead (3ed's class)
  - two orchestrators never run at once
- The sandbox dispatch door's request validation.
- The report-only-worker refusal: the TS collect and the Go executor must agree (the dyo/94u pair).
- Repo-config parsing.
- The gateway's Workers-AI-only allow-list.
Load hegel-skill (github.com/hegeldev/hegel-skill) when writing these. Report what PBT found.
request.title: Property-test the Run Workflow's supervision loop with Hegel (TypeScript)
